# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]

## For Patients

You are our passion. Your stories inspire us to work harder at bringing innovations that can make
your experience easier, speed recovery and enable the best possible quality of life.

[Discover Patient Stories][83]

### More For Patients

support every step of your journey.

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet our commitments – every
day and everywhere.

[Learn More About Our Leadership][90]

For nearly a century, we have made a meaningful difference in global healthcare while creating
lasting value for the communities we serve.

This is where an inclusive community of diverse individuals is driven to go beyond what is, to what
is possible in healthcare.

[Learn More About Careers at Baxter][92]

For more than 90 years, we’ve been focused on our commitment to save and sustain lives with
innovations that elevate patient care, improve outcomes and drive healthcare transformation.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]


[Patient pictured kneeling next to her Golden Retriever]
[Patient Story][53]

### From Pump to Pup: Finding Comfort in 'Baxter'

Izzy, a young cancer fighter and survivor, loves her dog, Baxter, named after the brand she saw on
the infusion pumps that delivered her chemotherapy.

[Read More][54]
[nurse smiling and standing next to a window ]
[Healthcare Insights][55]

### Technology and Service Support Chronic Disease Management at Home

Conditions such as hypertension, respiratory illnesses and cardiac issues can be monitored
effectively with innovative tools and connected devices.

[Read More][56]
[group event at a baseball game]
[People of Baxter][57]

### The Power of Teamwork to Support Patient Care

Teams bridged the pandemic and borders to bring an innovative ICU bed to life.

[Read More][58]
[Collage of images showing innovations in a manufacturing setting]
[Healthcare Insights][59]

### Supply Chain Innovation Delivers More Nimble, Efficient Solutions

Leaders from Baxter speak about our evolutions in manufacturing and supply chain processes as we
emerge from the COVID-19 pandemic

[Read More][60]
[Kim sitting at her desk smiling]
[People of Baxter][61]

### A Teacher at Heart

After losing her parents to heart disease, Kim resolved to share her knowledge about cardiac
monitoring with HCPs to identify potential issues early.

[Read More][62]

## Our Commitment to Healthcare Professionals and Patients

We are committed to supporting patients and healthcare professionals with innovations that are
driven by compassion for their journeys, a passion to improve care and the ambition to transform the
future of healthcare.

[A doctor in a hospital room looks off to the side]

## Products for Healthcare Professionals

### Primary Care [ Primary Care Go to Primary Care ][71]

Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
vitals monitoring and vision screening

[ Go to Primary Care ][72]

### Hospital Care [ Hospital Care Go to Hospital Care ][73]

Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
workflows

[ Go to Hospital Care ][74]

### Surgical Care [ Surgical Care Go to Surgical Care ][75]

Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
outcomes

[ Go to Surgical Care ][76]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][77]

Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and at
home

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][78]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][79]

Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve mobility

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][80]

### Our Products [ Our Products Go to Our Products ][81]

Enabling clinicians to treat patients more efficiently and effectively across care settings,
including in the office-based practice, inpatient care, outpatient care and at home

[ Go to Our Products ][82]
[Two ladies have a discussion in a coffee shop]

## For Patients

You are our passion. Your stories inspire us to work harder at bringing innovations that can make
your experience easier, speed recovery and enable the best possible quality of life.

[Discover Patient Stories][83]

### More For Patients

### General Healthcare [ General Healthcare Go to General Healthcare ][84]

Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
support every step of your journey.

[ Go to General Healthcare ][85]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][86]

When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide clinical nutrition
options to help you regain your nutritional status.

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][87]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][88]

We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven respiratory
therapy in the hospital and at home.

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][89]

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet our commitments – every
day and everywhere.

[Learn More About Our Leadership][90]

### Our Corporate Responsibility

For nearly a century, we have made a meaningful difference in global healthcare while creating
lasting value for the communities we serve.

[Learn More About Our Corporate Responsibility][91]

### Careers

This is where an inclusive community of diverse individuals is driven to go beyond what is, to what
is possible in healthcare.

[Learn More About Careers at Baxter][92]

### Our History

For more than 90 years, we’ve been focused on our commitment to save and sustain lives with
innovations that elevate patient care, improve outcomes and drive healthcare transformation.

[Learn More About Our History][93]

# Rare Disease and Specialty Pharmacy

Our holistic, collaborative approach brings together providers, patients and manufacturers like
never before. This unique approach leads to exceptional service, clinical expertise, and better
outcomes for all.

[Computer icon]

## Let’s improve outcomes together

Our priority is providing an exceptional experience that puts our patients first. With a focus on
improving clinical outcomes, our high-touch and customized treatment plans allow our pharmacists to
provide an elevated level of service for patients with chronic conditions and rare and orphan
diseases. As a full-service pharmacy, we’re better positioned than other specialty services to build
connections throughout the healthcare continuum that result in the best possible care.
[Flexible Icon]

#### Exceptional Service

That allows our patients easy access to certified specialty pharmacists who are always available to
provide high-touch care.
[Reduce Icon]

#### Clinical Expertise

For patients with rare and orphan diseases. Our long history of being a center of excellence means
they’ll get the best care from our expert pharmacists.
[Improved Icon]

#### Better Outcomes

From adherence programs to clinical protocols, our clinical teams keep patients at the center of
everything we do.

## Delivering value
## at every step

Our full range of specialty pharmacy services bring a new level of service to your patients and the
providers in your network. We provide customized programs that improve patient outcomes using the
following methods:
* Time-saving referrals
* Patient advocacy - Patient assistance programs, alternative foundation funding
* Reimbursement assistance - Benefit investigations, prior authorization assistance
* Customized refill reminders
* Access to limited-distribution medications and devices
* Personal case managers
* Clinical interventions and side effect monitoring
* Medication administration training
* Customized refill reminders, including personal phone calls and digital engagement
* Disease-specific patient education resources
* Patient adherence tracking and reporting
* Package tracking, temperature controlled

## Personalized service.
## Focused care.

Delivering exceptional patient care on a personal level is our biggest priority. Our certified
specialty pharmacists bring deep clinical experience to every patient encounter. We are specialists
in rare and orphan diseases and provide over 100 limited distribution drugs (LDDs) to our patients
through our pharmaceutical manufacture partners. From seamless coordination with physicians to
proactive patient support, we provide personalized collaboration across the care continuum to drive
better outcomes.
[Scientist in protective gear holding a blue pill with gloved hand in laboratory"]

#### Rare Disease Specialists

Focused support for patients who have rare and orphan diseases.

[Close-up of prescription capsules with medicine bottles in background on pharmacy counter"]

#### Access You Can Count On

Limited-distribution provider for a wide range of specialized medications
A direct result of our proactive, personalized care coordination.

[Diverse team of doctors and nurses collaborating in a hospital meeting]

#### Best in class patient care

A direct result of proactive, personalized care coordination results in better outcomes and patient
satisfaction.

## Become part of our community

Want to connect with VytlOne Specialty Pharmacy or explore opportunities? Get in touch with us
today.

Our holistic, collaborative approach brings together providers, patients and manufacturers like
never before. This unique approach leads to exceptional service, clinical expertise, and better
outcomes for all.

## Let’s improve outcomes together

Our priority is providing an exceptional experience that puts our patients first. With a focus on
improving clinical outcomes, our high-touch and customized treatment plans allow our pharmacists to
provide an elevated level of service for patients with chronic conditions and rare and orphan
diseases. As a full-service pharmacy, we’re better positioned than other specialty services to build
connections throughout the healthcare continuum that result in the best possible care.
[Flexible Icon]

#### Exceptional Service

That allows our patients easy access to certified specialty pharmacists who are always available to
provide high-touch care.
[Reduce Icon]

#### Clinical Expertise

For patients with rare and orphan diseases. Our long history of being a center of excellence means
they’ll get the best care from our expert pharmacists.
[Improved Icon]

#### Better Outcomes

From adherence programs to clinical protocols, our clinical teams keep patients at the center of
everything we do.

## Delivering value
## at every step

Our full range of specialty pharmacy services bring a new level of service to your patients and the
providers in your network. We provide customized programs that improve patient outcomes using the
following methods:
* Time-saving referrals
* Patient advocacy - Patient assistance programs, alternative foundation funding
* Reimbursement assistance - Benefit investigations, prior authorization assistance
* Customized refill reminders
* Access to limited-distribution medications and devices
* Personal case managers
* Clinical interventions and side effect monitoring
* Medication administration training
* Customized refill reminders, including personal phone calls and digital engagement
* Disease-specific patient education resources
* Patient adherence tracking and reporting
* Package tracking, temperature controlled

## Personalized service.
## Focused care.

Delivering exceptional patient care on a personal level is our biggest priority. Our certified
specialty pharmacists bring deep clinical experience to every patient encounter. We are specialists
in rare and orphan diseases and provide over 100 limited distribution drugs (LDDs) to our patients
through our pharmaceutical manufacture partners. From seamless coordination with physicians to
proactive patient support, we provide personalized collaboration across the care continuum to drive
better outcomes.
[Scientist in protective gear holding a blue pill with gloved hand in laboratory"]

[Close-up of prescription capsules with medicine bottles in background on pharmacy counter"]

[Diverse team of doctors and nurses collaborating in a hospital meeting]

#### Best in class patient care

A direct result of proactive, personalized care coordination results in better outcomes and patient
satisfaction.

Want to connect with VytlOne Specialty Pharmacy or explore opportunities? Get in touch with us
today.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

been a hub for medical tourism, and now it has become an epicentre for pharmaceutical manufacturing,
alongside the world’s medicinal exporter and supplier of all medicines to create a world that is
healthier and happier. We are proud to represent India as an Indian pharmaceutical manufacturing

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

As a result, we have grown into leading pharmaceutical drug manufacturers over the years. With the
goodwill and trust of our customers, the best is yet to come!

[Sign In][6]Book a Demo

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.
  Signals
  Hiring
  Field sales push
  12 AE roles, 3 metros
  Product
  New API surface
  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.
Testimonials

## What our customers are saying
* ### Knowing where to look
  
  "A competitor quietly sunsetted a feature — no announcement, no changelog, no blog post. The only
  trace was a small edit buried in their developer docs. ForesightIQ flagged it."
  
  [Mitch Eger]
  Mitch EgerProduct Marketing Manager, Polygon Labs
* ### Signals incumbent tools miss
  
  "Crayon missed an entire Square ads campaign. ForesightIQ caught it — screenshots and all — and
  it's directly shaped how our Brand team positioned our next campaign."
  
  [Min Chi]
  Min ChiSenior Manager, Insights, Public SaaS Company
* ### Future focused insights
  
  "ForesightIQ isn't a rearview mirror. It shows me where companies are headed next."
  
  [Marco Burgarello]
  Marco BurgarelloGTM Leader, Nextiva

Sources

## Beyond the usual sources

We monitor the hidden sources everyone misses plus integrate custom sources specific to your
industry.

Features

## Intelligence that gives you the edge

[Zero in on what matters]

### Zero in on what matters

Define the product lines, regions, or initiatives you actually care about — and filter out
everything else.

[Connected signals, not alerts]

### Connected signals, not alerts

Patterns across thousands of data points, not isolated alerts to wade through.

[Every signal fully sourced]

### Every signal fully sourced

Every insight links back to the LinkedIn post, job description, or doc change that revealed it.

[Insights you can act on]

### Insights you can act on

Strategic implications, not data dumps — what it means, why now, and how to respond.

[Predict moves months in advance]

### Predict moves months in advance

Forecasts of product launches, market expansions, and organizational pivots — with confidence
scores.

Connect with us

# Advancing science.
# Amplifying impact.

[ What We Do ][201]

Grifols is a leading global healthcare company. Our trusted and innovative plasma-derived medicines,
other biopharmaceuticals and solutions in transfusion medicine enable millions of patients around
the world to lead more productive lives.

Since our founding in 1909, our ever-growing mastery of plasma, diagnostics and life sciences,
backed by our ethical leadership and industry-leading quality and safety standards, have contributed
to a healthier and more sustainable society.

## TIME and Forbes rank us among the world’s best companies

TIME magazine has recognized Grifols as one of the world’s top companies for the third consecutive
year. Additionally, for the second year in a row, Forbes has named Grifols one of the World’s Best
Employers.

This achievement reflects our relentless commitment to our people and long-term impact.

## Latest news

immunoglobulins

## Barcelona honors Víctor Grífols i Lucas

The Barcelona City Council has named the street where the company’s institutional headquarters is
located after Víctor Grífols i Lucas. This tribute recognizes a pioneer in the biomedical industry
who, for more than six decades, was the heart and driving force behind Grifols. Uncover the story
behind Grifols’ legacy.

[ Read more ][206]

## Commitment to people and the planet

Aligned with the United Nations plan to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals defined in its
2030 Agenda, we work every day to do more and do better to contribute to the health and quality of
life of people around the world.

The patients we serve are able to lead better lives. Patients inspire the work we do every day.

[ Read more ][207]
Innovation

## Scientific innovation at work

Our deep and expanding knowledge of plasma and the life sciences is helping us better understand
human health and research potential treatments to improve it.

[ Read more ][208]

## Get to know us

Our history

We trace our roots back to 1909 when Dr. Josep Antoni Grifols i Roig founded a clinical analysis
laboratory in Barcelona, the precursor to Laboratorios Grifols.

Grifols' mission, to improve people's health and well-being, has patients, donors and society at the

# Advancing science.
# Amplifying impact.

[ What We Do ][201]

Grifols is a leading global healthcare company. Our trusted and innovative plasma-derived medicines,
other biopharmaceuticals and solutions in transfusion medicine enable millions of patients around
the world to lead more productive lives.

Since our founding in 1909, our ever-growing mastery of plasma, diagnostics and life sciences,
backed by our ethical leadership and industry-leading quality and safety standards, have contributed
to a healthier and more sustainable society.

## TIME and Forbes rank us among the world’s best companies

TIME magazine has recognized Grifols as one of the world’s top companies for the third consecutive
year. Additionally, for the second year in a row, Forbes has named Grifols one of the World’s Best
Employers.

This achievement reflects our relentless commitment to our people and long-term impact.

## Barcelona honors Víctor Grífols i Lucas

The Barcelona City Council has named the street where the company’s institutional headquarters is
located after Víctor Grífols i Lucas. This tribute recognizes a pioneer in the biomedical industry
who, for more than six decades, was the heart and driving force behind Grifols. Uncover the story
behind Grifols’ legacy.

[ Read more ][206]

## Commitment to people and the planet

Aligned with the United Nations plan to achieve the Sustainable Development Goals defined in its
2030 Agenda, we work every day to do more and do better to contribute to the health and quality of
life of people around the world.

The patients we serve are able to lead better lives. Patients inspire the work we do every day.

Our deep and expanding knowledge of plasma and the life sciences is helping us better understand

## Longevity Clinic Bangkok: Your Questions Answered

Direct answers. No fluff.

What is Healthi Life?+

Healthi Life is a doctor-led urban longevity house in Bangkok. We combine Recovery & Performance
treatments with 3 to 12-month Longevity Programs, built around up to 300 biomarkers tracked and
re-tested over time. Founded February 2025 in Ekkamai by Dr. Sarassawadee Suwanjinda (Dr. Petch,
IBLM-certified, Chief Medical Strategy Officer), Dr. Napat Hunsajarupan (Dr. First, Chief Medical
Officer), and Vincent Caradec (CEO & Founder).

How much does a longevity program cost?+

Individual Longevity Programs span four tiers, priced on consultation: Reset (90 days), Restoration
(6 months), Reversal (9 months, our signature), and Blueprint (12 months). Corporate Longevity
Programs span four tiers: Protect ฿350,000, Perform ฿500,000, Precision ฿700,000, and Prestige
฿900,000 (per executive per year, no minimum executives). Fly-In Programs range from ฿50,000 to
฿550,000+ across four tiers and include a 30 to 90 day post-treatment follow-up. Peptide Programs
are priced on consultation.

What does Recovery & Regeneration include?+

Recovery & Regeneration covers à la carte treatments available from a single visit. Five categories:
Energy & Recovery (IV Therapy from ฿4,500, NAD+ Power Boost ฿6,000), Biomarkers (Health Check-Up
฿10,500 to ฿90,000), Cellular Therapy (Stem Cell knee ฿80K, body ฿419K, Exosomes ฿35K), Skin & Hair
(PRP, Pico, Stem Cell Face ฿59K to ฿119K), and Private Testing (STD, Hormone Mapping from ฿2,000).

Is NAD+ at Healthi Life better than oral supplements?+

NAD+ delivered intravenously achieves 100% bioavailability. Oral NAD+ supplements achieve 2 to 10%
bioavailability due to first-pass metabolism. NAD+ Power Boost at Healthi Life is ฿6,000 and is
administered by licensed physicians under Dr. First, Chief Medical Officer.

How is Healthi Life different from Clinique La Prairie or Human Longevity?+

Healthi Life delivers comparable doctor-led longevity protocols at 60 to 70% lower cost. We are
based in Bangkok, not Switzerland or San Diego, with the same biomarker depth (up to 300 markers)
and physician oversight. We are an urban longevity house, not a destination spa or retreat, built
for ongoing relationships rather than one-off check-ups.

Can I come from abroad?+

Yes. Our Fly-In Programs span four tiers: Longevity Diagnostic ฿50,000, Vital Renewal ฿140,000,
Cellular Renaissance ฿280,000, and Total Regeneration ฿550,000+. All include a 30 to 90 day
post-treatment follow-up. Bangkok's Suvarnabhumi Airport is 25 minutes from Ekkamai. We work in
English, Thai, Mandarin, Arabic, French, and Japanese.

Who runs Healthi Life?+

Three co-founders. Dr. Petch (Chief Medical Strategy Officer, IBLM-certified) leads the Longevity
Programs. Dr. First (Chief Medical Officer) leads Recovery & Regeneration. Vincent Caradec is CEO &
Founder.

How do I book a consultation?+

Book a 30-minute discovery consultation at healthi-life.com or call +66 91 999 1744. The discovery
call is doctor-guided with no commitment. Our urban longevity house is in Ekkamai, Bangkok.

Can't find your answer?

## Longevity Clinic Bangkok: Your Questions Answered

Direct answers. No fluff.

What is Healthi Life?+

Healthi Life is a doctor-led urban longevity house in Bangkok. We combine Recovery & Performance
treatments with 3 to 12-month Longevity Programs, built around up to 300 biomarkers tracked and
re-tested over time. Founded February 2025 in Ekkamai by Dr. Sarassawadee Suwanjinda (Dr. Petch,
IBLM-certified, Chief Medical Strategy Officer), Dr. Napat Hunsajarupan (Dr. First, Chief Medical
Officer), and Vincent Caradec (CEO & Founder).

How much does a longevity program cost?+

Individual Longevity Programs span four tiers, priced on consultation: Reset (90 days), Restoration
(6 months), Reversal (9 months, our signature), and Blueprint (12 months). Corporate Longevity
Programs span four tiers: Protect ฿350,000, Perform ฿500,000, Precision ฿700,000, and Prestige
฿900,000 (per executive per year, no minimum executives). Fly-In Programs range from ฿50,000 to
฿550,000+ across four tiers and include a 30 to 90 day post-treatment follow-up. Peptide Programs
are priced on consultation.

What does Recovery & Regeneration include?+

Recovery & Regeneration covers à la carte treatments available from a single visit. Five categories:
Energy & Recovery (IV Therapy from ฿4,500, NAD+ Power Boost ฿6,000), Biomarkers (Health Check-Up
฿10,500 to ฿90,000), Cellular Therapy (Stem Cell knee ฿80K, body ฿419K, Exosomes ฿35K), Skin & Hair
(PRP, Pico, Stem Cell Face ฿59K to ฿119K), and Private Testing (STD, Hormone Mapping from ฿2,000).

Is NAD+ at Healthi Life better than oral supplements?+

NAD+ delivered intravenously achieves 100% bioavailability. Oral NAD+ supplements achieve 2 to 10%
bioavailability due to first-pass metabolism. NAD+ Power Boost at Healthi Life is ฿6,000 and is
administered by licensed physicians under Dr. First, Chief Medical Officer.

How is Healthi Life different from Clinique La Prairie or Human Longevity?+

Healthi Life delivers comparable doctor-led longevity protocols at 60 to 70% lower cost. We are
based in Bangkok, not Switzerland or San Diego, with the same biomarker depth (up to 300 markers)
and physician oversight. We are an urban longevity house, not a destination spa or retreat, built
for ongoing relationships rather than one-off check-ups.

Can I come from abroad?+

Yes. Our Fly-In Programs span four tiers: Longevity Diagnostic ฿50,000, Vital Renewal ฿140,000,
Cellular Renaissance ฿280,000, and Total Regeneration ฿550,000+. All include a 30 to 90 day
post-treatment follow-up. Bangkok's Suvarnabhumi Airport is 25 minutes from Ekkamai. We work in
English, Thai, Mandarin, Arabic, French, and Japanese.

Who runs Healthi Life?+

Three co-founders. Dr. Petch (Chief Medical Strategy Officer, IBLM-certified) leads the Longevity
Programs. Dr. First (Chief Medical Officer) leads Recovery & Regeneration. Vincent Caradec is CEO &
Founder.

How do I book a consultation?+

Book a 30-minute discovery consultation at healthi-life.com or call +66 91 999 1744. The discovery
call is doctor-guided with no commitment. Our urban longevity house is in Ekkamai, Bangkok.

* [ Customer Support ][186]

Pulling into the parking lot before most of the world is even awake.
Or walking out under the stars at the end of a 12-hour shift.

No matter who you are:
Clinician, caregiver or administrator, you carry a heavy load.
The weight of decisions. Of team members. Of patients and families.
Of why you got into this in the first place.

### 
### ICU MEDICAL

## WE SEE YOU

## And we build for you.

Every tool is designed to meet the real-world demands of every shift, every patient, every moment.
They're made to simplify complexity. To streamline workflows. To help reduce risks before they
happen. To support decisions under pressure.

##### All so you can be present, move with purpose and precision and do what you do best.

[ View Products ][187]

### From IV lines to vital signs, we're with you at the heart of care.
* [
  Products
  Infusion Therapy
  
  From catheters to pumps, you can standardize without clinical compromise, so every drop reaches
  patients safely and every shift runs smoother.
  
  ][188]
* [
  Products
  Pharmacy Preparation
  
  Compounding automation, closed system transfer devices, and IV safety software built to give you
  less pressure and more performance.
  
  ][189]
* [
  Products
  Airway Management
  
  From tracheostomy tubes to breathing support, our tools are designed to make every breath count
  and help everyone breathe a little easier.
  
  ][190]
* [
  Products
  Hemodynamic Monitoring
  
  Monitoring technologies that bring clarity to critical decisions without slowing you down.
  
  ][191]
* [
  Products
  Temperature Management
  
  From fluid warming to temperature probes, we help you protect patients perioperatively, so they
  stay safe and stable in your care.
  
  ][192]
* [
  Products
  Renal Care
  
  Help protect hemodialysis catheters, reduce infection risks, and build the trust that renal care
  depends on.
  
  ][193]
* [
  Products
  Pain Management
  
  From spinal and epidural to regional blocks and diagnostic trays, we give you the right tools to
  ease pain and deliver comfort with confidence.
  
  ][194]

[IV Precision Pump Family]

### Introducing the IV Performance Platform

Lead a new wave of IV therapy performance with an intuitive platform designed to help bring safety,
simplicity, and clarity to patient care. Comprised of Plum Duo^{™} and Plum Solo^{™}* precision IV
pumps and LifeShield^{™} IV safety software, this fully IV-EHR interoperable, future-ready platform
empowers you to raise the performance of your IV therapy practice—helping to enhance safety and
efficiency across all IV touchpoints.

*Plum Duo v1.2 and Plum Solo v1.0

[ Explore the New Wave of IV Safety ][195]

## Latest news

Stay up to date with our latest news

  IV Connectors with Powerful New Infection Control Data
  New labeling clearance highlights peer-reviewed evidence showing hospitals that standardize on
  Clave technology achieve significantly greater infection reduction and cost savings compared to
  non-Clave hospitals.
  ][196]

  ICU Medical and VisionHealth Launch MyAcapella^{™} Digital OPEP Coach to Improve OPEP Therapy and
  Adherence for Respiratory Patients
  New digital coaching app enhances patient experience and clinician oversight through guided
  therapy, reminders, and adherence tracking.
  ][197]

  News / May 01, 2025
  ICU Medical, Inc. and Otsuka Pharmaceutical Factory, Inc. Complete Joint Venture to Bolster IV
  Solutions Manufacturing and Innovation in North America
  The partnership creates one of the largest global IV solutions manufacturing networks with
  combined production of an estimated 1.4 billion annual units and aims to bring additional supply
  chain resiliency and new innovation to the North American IV solutions market.
  ][198]

  ICU Medical Introduces Its New Category of Infusion Devices With FDA Clearances of Plum Solo^{™}

  ][199]

Nashville's Premier IV Bar

Accelerate healing, boost wellness, and achieve optimal hydration with IV solutions tailored to your
unique needs. IntraVenous Solutions provides a luxurious experience where you can relax knowing
you’re doing something good for your body and mind. Our services are perfect for a weekend
pick-me-up or ongoing wellness support. Whatever your needs, we have an IV solution for you.

From your everyday hydration needs to tailored and advanced solutions, our IV bar in Nashville helps
you achieve your wellness goals. All of our wellness infusions feature powerful vitamins, minerals,
and antioxidants to help you recover from an illness, boost energy, promote skin health, and more.

With our wellness infusions, clients can choose from:
* **Immunity Boost:** This powerful solution with antioxidants and vitamins helps you feel better
  when battling an illness. We also recommend this infusion to prevent illness and allergies.
* **The Recovery Plus:** After the nights you stay out a little too late, this infusion helps you
  rebound quickly. A blend of vitamins, minerals, and specialized medicines fights nausea, reduces
  headaches, and replenishes lost electrolytes.
* **The Works:** Our most popular infusion covers all the bases of IV therapy. This blend supports a
  healthy immune system, enhances your metabolism, and improves skin and hair health.
* **Myers’ Cocktail:** The vitamin “cocktail” helps fight fatigue and keep the immune system strong.
  Our curated infusion helps clients maintain wellness and supports longevity.
* **Get Up and Go:** From beating jet lag to recovering from an illness, this infusion helps you
  bounce back, *energized*. Hydrate and fight off fatigue with our blend of vitamins, amino acids,
  and electrolytes.
* **Skin Wellness**: Support your skin on the cellular level with our beauty infusion. Specialized
  vitamins and minerals promote a clearer complexion by nourishing the skin barrier.
* **NAD+ Prime:** Burnt out? Bounce back with an infusion formulated with a powerful coenzyme to
  keep you performing at your best.
* **Hydration:** Electrolytes keep you hydrated to optimize your health. Our classic infusion helps
  those suffering from dehydration or anyone needing a hydration boost.

Aside from enhancing your immune system and promoting hydration, we offer advanced therapies using
vitamin C and ozone. Our experienced team and modern technologies can promote healing, renewal, and
regeneration on the cellular level.

We help you manage symptoms of chronic conditions and immune diseases with innovative therapies at
our IV bar in Nashville.

Our specialty infusions include:
* **High-Dose Vitamin C:** Revitalize your immune system with a powerful dose of vitamin C. The
  vitamin enhances tissue repair and cellular renewal, making it ideal for those going through
  cancer treatment.
* **Basic Ozone IV:** Adding ozone to an infusion supplies oxygen throughout the body. Cells and
  tissues use oxygen to regenerate, providing anti-aging benefits and relief from chronic
  conditions.
* **EBOO:** Our advanced ozone therapy uses a dialysis filter, medical-grade ozone, and a UV light
  to optimize cell function. EBOO oxygenates the blood and helps clients fight off age-related
  disease and autoimmune disorders.

No matter what brings you to our clinic, our infusions provide symptom relief and overall renewal.
Our solutions can boost an existing wellness routine or help you recharge and rehydrate when needed.

Nashville's Premier IV Bar

Accelerate healing, boost wellness, and achieve optimal hydration with IV solutions tailored to your
unique needs. IntraVenous Solutions provides a luxurious experience where you can relax knowing
you’re doing something good for your body and mind. Our services are perfect for a weekend
pick-me-up or ongoing wellness support. Whatever your needs, we have an IV solution for you.

From your everyday hydration needs to tailored and advanced solutions, our IV bar in Nashville helps
you achieve your wellness goals. All of our wellness infusions feature powerful vitamins, minerals,
and antioxidants to help you recover from an illness, boost energy, promote skin health, and more.

With our wellness infusions, clients can choose from:
* **Immunity Boost:** This powerful solution with antioxidants and vitamins helps you feel better
  when battling an illness. We also recommend this infusion to prevent illness and allergies.
* **The Recovery Plus:** After the nights you stay out a little too late, this infusion helps you
  rebound quickly. A blend of vitamins, minerals, and specialized medicines fights nausea, reduces
  headaches, and replenishes lost electrolytes.
* **The Works:** Our most popular infusion covers all the bases of IV therapy. This blend supports a
  healthy immune system, enhances your metabolism, and improves skin and hair health.
* **Myers’ Cocktail:** The vitamin “cocktail” helps fight fatigue and keep the immune system strong.
  Our curated infusion helps clients maintain wellness and supports longevity.
* **Get Up and Go:** From beating jet lag to recovering from an illness, this infusion helps you
  bounce back, *energized*. Hydrate and fight off fatigue with our blend of vitamins, amino acids,
  and electrolytes.
* **Skin Wellness**: Support your skin on the cellular level with our beauty infusion. Specialized
  vitamins and minerals promote a clearer complexion by nourishing the skin barrier.
* **NAD+ Prime:** Burnt out? Bounce back with an infusion formulated with a powerful coenzyme to
  keep you performing at your best.
* **Hydration:** Electrolytes keep you hydrated to optimize your health. Our classic infusion helps
  those suffering from dehydration or anyone needing a hydration boost.

Aside from enhancing your immune system and promoting hydration, we offer advanced therapies using
vitamin C and ozone. Our experienced team and modern technologies can promote healing, renewal, and
regeneration on the cellular level.

We help you manage symptoms of chronic conditions and immune diseases with innovative therapies at
our IV bar in Nashville.

Our specialty infusions include:
* **High-Dose Vitamin C:** Revitalize your immune system with a powerful dose of vitamin C. The
  vitamin enhances tissue repair and cellular renewal, making it ideal for those going through
  cancer treatment.
* **Basic Ozone IV:** Adding ozone to an infusion supplies oxygen throughout the body. Cells and
  tissues use oxygen to regenerate, providing anti-aging benefits and relief from chronic
  conditions.
* **EBOO:** Our advanced ozone therapy uses a dialysis filter, medical-grade ozone, and a UV light
  to optimize cell function. EBOO oxygenates the blood and helps clients fight off age-related
  disease and autoimmune disorders.

No matter what brings you to our clinic, our infusions provide symptom relief and overall renewal.
Our solutions can boost an existing wellness routine or help you recharge and rehydrate when needed.

## Naturopathic Medicine in San Diego, CA

### Your Partner For Optimized Health







Our Whole Body Approach

Nature & Science Medicine is a professional & holistic medical clinic located in Encinitas,
California. We combine conventional diagnostic testing with evidence-based natural treatments to
provide our patients with highly effective results.

> “I was referred to Dr McNulty by a trusted friend after finding out I had stage 1 vocal cord
> cancer. Out of all the doctors I’ve seen over past few months, Nikodemas has been the most
> informative, helpful and honest doctor. The treatments plan he suggested has made me feel much
> better.”

— John B.
 
 

# Featured Services

### IV Therapy & Vitamin Injections

IV therapy can be beneficial for many medical conditions including vitamin and mineral deficiencies,
food sensitivities, stress and fatigue, inflammation, immune system dysfunction, and poor digestion
— as well as acute and chronic illnesses such as cancer. With IV therapy, the nutrients go directly
into your bloodstream to be utilized by the body — allowing for 100% absorption.

[ Learn About Our IV Services ][50]

### Holistic & Naturopathic Medicine

At Nature & Science Medicine, our team of California-licensed naturopathic medical doctors (NMDs)
has expertise in a wide range of specialities — so you can benefit from personalized medical
treatments. Our naturopathic medicine in San Diego, CA includes services like [preventive
medicine][51], [mental health and mood support][52], [supportive cancer care][53], [gastrointestinal
health services][54], [hormone therapy][55] and [pediatrics][56].

[ Learn About Our Holistic Approach ][57]
 

> “Dr. Biller was recommended to me by a friend and I’m so thankful I went to see her. I’ve been a
> patient now for over a year and she has not only helped me heal and live symptom free but I’m now
> living above the wellness line. Her time and dedication to finding the root cause of my symptoms
> has been life changing.”

— Brittany P.

# Introducing Titan XT

The Next Generation Automated Dispensing System

[Learn More][40]

Defining. Delivering. Outcomes.

## Supporting Your Journey to the Autonomous Pharmacy

Uncover cost savings, improve efficiency, gain supply chain control, and support compliance.

[Learn More][41]
* Robotics
* Smart Devices
* Software
* Services

### Robotics

Reducing the potential for human error

Removing human interaction from medication management processes supports safety and efficiency,
while automating manual tasks allows staff to focus on higher value activities.

### Smart Devices

Streamlining workflows for safer, more efficient patient care

Designed to improve workflows, while closing gaps in safety and inventory visibility, Omnicell’s
smart devices enable clinicians to spend less time managing medications and more time caring for
patients.

### Software

Providing visibility and insights to the pharmacy supply chain

Intelligent software solutions offer greater visibility to medication inventory, providing powerful
data insights to optimize the pharmacy supply chain to reduce medication waste and realize cost
savings.

### Services

Maximizing value for your pharmacy technology

Expert technicians and strategists serve as an extension of your pharmacy operations to support
improved efficiency, deliver accelerated time-to-value, and enhance patient care.

### Peripherally Inserted Central Catheter (PICC): Building a Safe, Precise, and Efficient
### "Lifeline" — 2026 Global PICC Product and Technology Frontiers

In clinical settings such as oncology chemotherapy, long-term parenteral nutrition, intensive care,
and prolonged antibiotic therapy, establishing a safe and reliable central venous access is often
directly linked to patient outcomes and quality of life. The Peripherally Inserted Central Catheter
(PICC), owing to its minimally invasive nature, safety profile, and bedside operability, is
increasingly becoming the first-line choice for intravenous therapy.

][208]
[
June 30 2026

### Cardiovascular Interventional Products: Innovation and Breakthroughs Reshaping the Industry

Cardiovascular disease remains one of the most significant global health threats. In China,
approximately 330 million people suffer from cardiovascular diseases, including about 11.39 million
with coronary artery disease (CAD). Amid accelerating population aging and the widespread adoption
of minimally invasive therapeutic concepts, cardiovascular interventional products are evolving at
an unprecedented pace. From the “leave nothing behind” strategy of drug-coated balloons to
breakthroughs in intravascular lithotripsy (IVL), from the approval of the first domestically
developed interventional artificial heart to the clinical deployment of vascular interventional
surgical robots, a series of milestones indicate that cardiovascular interventional therapy has
entered a brand-new phase. Simultaneously, volume-based procurement (VBP) policies continue to
reshape the industry landscape, domestic substitution is accelerating, and the cardiovascular
intervention sector is moving from “data prosperity” towards “value creation”.

### Peripherally Inserted Central Catheter (PICC): Building a Safe, Precise, and Efficient
### "Lifeline" — 2026 Global PICC Product and Technology Frontiers

In clinical settings such as oncology chemotherapy, long-term parenteral nutrition, intensive care,
and prolonged antibiotic therapy, establishing a safe and reliable central venous access is often
directly linked to patient outcomes and quality of life. The Peripherally Inserted Central Catheter
(PICC), owing to its minimally invasive nature, safety profile, and bedside operability, is
increasingly becoming the first-line choice for intravenous therapy.

][208]
[
June 30 2026

### Cardiovascular Interventional Products: Innovation and Breakthroughs Reshaping the Industry

Cardiovascular disease remains one of the most significant global health threats. In China,
approximately 330 million people suffer from cardiovascular diseases, including about 11.39 million
with coronary artery disease (CAD). Amid accelerating population aging and the widespread adoption
of minimally invasive therapeutic concepts, cardiovascular interventional products are evolving at
an unprecedented pace. From the “leave nothing behind” strategy of drug-coated balloons to
breakthroughs in intravascular lithotripsy (IVL), from the approval of the first domestically
developed interventional artificial heart to the clinical deployment of vascular interventional
surgical robots, a series of milestones indicate that cardiovascular interventional therapy has
entered a brand-new phase. Simultaneously, volume-based procurement (VBP) policies continue to
reshape the industry landscape, domestic substitution is accelerating, and the cardiovascular
intervention sector is moving from “data prosperity” towards “value creation”.

[Healthcare worker hangs a bag of Clinolipid on a stand]

Address malnutrition with clinical nutrition solutions designed to support individualized therapy,

[Baxter Novum Syringe Pump - Barcode Scan]

### Infusion Systems and Accessories

Standardize infusion delivery with systems and accessories designed to support safe medication
administration, efficient workflows and bedside confidence.

[Healthcare worker hangs an IV bag on a stand]

### IV Solutions

Support everyday care with a broad IV solutions portfolio designed to meet common medication and
hydration needs across acute care settings.

## Connect Smarter with DeviceBridge

Unlock integration for your Baxter devices and applications. **DeviceBridge** is our unified,
cloud-based gateway that securely connects **IQ Enterprise**, infusion pumps, vital signs monitors
and smart beds to your hospital’s EHR and IT systems. With robust security, common data exchange,
and user management features, **DeviceBridge** simplifies connectivity and scales to meet your
needs, with maintenance and updates handled by Baxter.

## Why Choose Baxter

Count on Baxter for reliable IV fluid and nutrition solution supply—no matter the challenge. Our
manufacturing and distribution teams are ready to deliver, every day. 

### #1 in Manufacturing Capacity

Six IV fluid manufacturing plants are located in Canada and the U.S., more than all other IV
suppliers combined.¹

### Broad Distribution Network

Six strategically-located mega-distribution centers are in the U.S. for rapid, reliable delivery for
hospitals and clinics.

### Proven Track Record

We put nearly 100 years of quality and innovation expertise into each of the one million+ IV bags we
make every day, right here in the U.S.

### $2.5+ Billion Invested¹

We’ve invested over $2.5 billion to expand our manufacturing network—so you can count on continuous
supply and rapid response, even in challenging times.

### A Range of Trusted Options

With Baxter, you can choose the IV product that fits your needs. Baxter’s **Viaflex** containers
have an extensive history of safe, effective care for decades, and we’re leading the transition to
DEHP-free options in full compliance with U.S. regulations. Our evolving portfolio ensures you’re
always ready for what’s next, with safety and choice at the forefront.

[A clinician wearing gloves and a mask hanging up a IV bag while looking behind her]
